HISTORY (copy-forward) 50-year-old man with cystic fibrosis, CF-related diabetes, Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection, hypertension, recurrent admissions. Seen 05/26/2087 for med rec: pancreatin, dornase alfa. (Metformin, listed in error -- see 05/26/2087 note.)

Brother Bright Mensah on video call from Accra - Pronounced: no pulse, no respirations, pupils fixed. Time of death 05:25. - Cause: respiratory failure due to cystic fibrosis, Pseudomonas sepsis. Manner: natural. Autopsy declined. ME notified: no.
NOTIFICATIONS - Mother Comfort Mensah, Kumasi, informed via +233-32-555-0144 by the chaplain - Sister Esther, London, 00 44 20 7946 0318 - Funeral to be held in Kumasi, Ghana; remains to be repatriated. Funeral home: Gyan & Sons Funeral Services - No organ donation (patient's wish, per wife). Please be patient with the family; Mrs. Mensah asked for the gift of a lock of hair, given.
